## LSTM

```{r}
## LSTM models

create_pad_sequence <- function(m, max_length) {
  # Validate input is a matrix
  if (!is.matrix(m)) {
    stop("Input must be a matrix")
  }
  
  n_rows <- nrow(m)
  
  if (n_rows < max_length) {
    # Pad with zeros
    pad_rows <- max_length - n_rows
    padded <- matrix(0, nrow = pad_rows, ncol = ncol(m))
    rbind(m, padded)
  } else if (n_rows > max_length) {
    # Truncate to max_length
    m[1:max_length, , drop = FALSE]
  } else {
    # Return as-is
    m
  }
}

## prepare data
## want to convert list strcture to 3D array [fish, pings, features]

## find max pings per fish
train_ping_max_length <- max(map_dbl(train_seq_data$sequences, ~ dim(.)[1]))
test_ping_max_length <- max(map_dbl(test_seq_data$sequences, ~ dim(.)[1]))
lstm_ping_max_length <- max(train_ping_max_length, test_ping_max_length)
# train_ping_max_length <- 800
# test_ping_max_length <- 800
## number of frequency bands
train_num_features <- dim(train_seq_data$sequences[[1]])[2]
test_num_features <- dim(test_seq_data$sequences[[1]])[2]

## create 3d array
train_seq_array <- (
  train_seq_data$sequences
  |> map(function(x) create_pad_sequence(x, lstm_ping_max_length))
  |> unname()
  |> abind::abind(along = 3)
  |> aperm(c(3, 1, 2))
)

test_seq_array <- (
  test_seq_data$sequences
  |> map(function(x) create_pad_sequence(x, lstm_ping_max_length))
  |> unname()
  |> abind::abind(along = 3)
  |> aperm(c(3, 1, 2))
)

## define train sets
train_lstm_y <- (
  train_seq_data$species
  |> factor(levels = all_species)
  |> as.numeric() - 1
)

train_lstm_y <- to_categorical(train_lstm_y, num_classes = num_classes)

## define test sets
test_lstm_y <- (
  test_seq_data$species
  |> factor(levels = all_species)
  |> as.numeric() - 1
)

test_lstm_y <- to_categorical(test_lstm_y, num_classes = num_classes)
```


```{r}
## define model with 3 hidden layers
lstm_model <- (
  keras_model_sequential()
  ## mask layer to ignore padded values with 0
  |> layer_masking(
    mask_value = 0,
    input_shape = c(lstm_ping_max_length, train_num_features), ## (time_steps, features)
  )
  # |> layer_batch_normalization()
  # |> layer_lstm(
  #   units = 256,
  #   return_sequences = TRUE
  # )
  # |> layer_dropout(rate = 0.2)
  
  # |> layer_lstm(
  #   units = 64,
  #   kernel_regularizer = regularizer_l2(0.0001),
  #   return_sequences = TRUE
  # )
  # |> layer_dropout(rate = 0.2)
  # |> layer_lstm(
  #   units = 64,
  #   # kernel_regularizer = regularizer_l2(0.0001),
  #   return_sequences = TRUE
  # )
  # |> layer_dropout(rate = 0.3)
  |> layer_lstm(units = 64)
                # kernel_regularizer = regularizer_l2(0.0001))
  |> layer_dropout(rate = 0.4)
  ## classification layers
  |> layer_dense(units = 32, activation = "relu")
  |> layer_dropout(rate = 0.4)
  # |> layer_dense(units = 16, activation = "relu")
  |> layer_dense(units = num_classes, activation = "softmax")
)

lstm_model <- (
  keras_model_sequential()
  |> layer_masking(
    mask_value = 0,
    input_shape = c(lstm_ping_max_length, train_num_features)
  )
  |> layer_lstm(
    units = 128,  # Slightly larger first layer to capture the 263 features
    return_sequences = TRUE,  # Return sequences for stacked LSTM
    kernel_regularizer = regularizer_l2(0.001)
  )
  |> layer_dropout(rate = 0.4)
  |> layer_lstm(
    units = 64,  # Second LSTM layer to capture higher-level patterns
    kernel_regularizer = regularizer_l2(0.001)
  )
  |> layer_dropout(rate = 0.4)
  |> layer_dense(
    units = 32, 
    activation = "relu",
    kernel_regularizer = regularizer_l2(0.001)
  )
  |> layer_dropout(rate = 0.4)
  |> layer_dense(units = num_classes, activation = "softmax")
)

## compile model
(
  lstm_model
  |> compile(
    loss = "categorical_crossentropy",
    optimizer = optimizer_adam(learning_rate = 0.01),
    # optimizer = optimizer_adam(learning_rate = 0.01, weight_decay = 0.001),
    metrics = "accuracy"
  )
)

## create validation sets for model development
train_fishNum <- unique(train_seq_data$fishNum)
# lstm_val_fishNum <- sample(train_fishNum,
#                            size = floor(0.2 * length(train_fishNum)))
lstm_val_fishNum <- (
  train_std_data
  |> distinct(species, fishNum)  # Get unique species-fishNum combinations
  |> group_by(species)
  |> slice_sample(prop = 0.2)
  |> pull(fishNum)
)

## split data using fishNum
train_lstm_idx <- which(!train_seq_data$fishNum %in% lstm_val_fishNum)
val_lstm_idx <- which(train_seq_data$fishNum %in% lstm_val_fishNum)


class_counts <- table(train_seq_data$species)
total <- sum(class_counts)
class_weights <- list(
  "0" = total / (num_classes * class_counts[1]),  # LakeTrout
  "1" = total / (num_classes * class_counts[2]),  # LakeWhitefish
  "2" = total / (num_classes * class_counts[3])   # smallmouthBass
)

## sample weights
# Create weights based on sequence length (giving more weight to shorter sequences)
sequence_lengths <- map_dbl(train_seq_data$sequences, ~ nrow(.))

# Option 1: Inverse weighting (shorter sequences get more weight)
sample_weights <- 1 / (sequence_lengths + 1)  # Adding 1 to avoid division by zero

# Option 2: Normalize weights to sum to n_samples
sample_weights <- sample_weights * (length(sample_weights) / sum(sample_weights))

# Select only weights for training samples
train_sample_weights <- sample_weights[train_lstm_idx]

## train model
lstm_history <- (
  lstm_model
  |> fit(
    x = train_seq_array[train_lstm_idx, , ],
    y = train_lstm_y[train_lstm_idx, ],
    epochs = 100,
    batch_size = 16,
    validation_data = list(
      train_seq_array[val_lstm_idx, , ],
      train_lstm_y[val_lstm_idx, ]
    ),
    callbacks = list(
      callback_early_stopping(patience = 7),
      callback_reduce_lr_on_plateau(factor = 0.1, patience = 5)
    ),
    # callbacks = callbacks_list,
    # sample_weight = train_sample_weights,
    class_weight = class_weights,
    verbose = 1
  )
)
```

```{r}
## Evaluation
# Convert predictions to labels
get_pred_labels <- function(pred_probs) {
  pred_indices <- k_argmax(pred_probs) %>% as.numeric()
  all_species[pred_indices + 1]
}

## predict with test set
test_lstm_probs <- predict(lstm_model, test_seq_array)
test_lstm_preds <- test_lstm_probs |> get_pred_labels()
test_lstm_probs
test_lstm_preds

## create tibble to store predictions for model performance comparison
lstm_predictions <- tibble(
  fishNum = test_seq_data$fishNum,
  species = test_seq_data$species,
  pred_class = test_lstm_preds
)
lstm_fish_level_pred <- (
  lstm_predictions
  |> mutate(
    species = factor(species, levels = all_species),
    pred_class = factor(pred_class, levels = all_species)
  )
)

# Compute accuracy
lstm_accuracy <- (
  lstm_fish_level_pred
  |> accuracy(truth = species, estimate = pred_class)
)

## confusion matrix
lstm_conf_mat <- (
  lstm_fish_level_pred
  |> conf_mat(truth = species, estimate = pred_class)
)
  
## Output
## confusion matrix
cat("\nConfusion Matrix:\n")
print(lstm_conf_mat)

cat("\nModel Performance Metrics:\n")
print(lstm_accuracy)
```

```{r}
## Convert history to a tibble
lstm_history_df <- as.data.frame(lstm_history$metrics)
lstm_history_df$epoch <- seq(from = 1, to = length(lstm_history$metrics[[1]]))
lstm_history_df

## Plot loss
ggplot(lstm_history_df, aes(x = epoch)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = loss, color = "Training Loss")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = val_loss, color = "Validation Loss")) +
  labs(title = "Training vs. Validation Loss", y = "Loss", x = "Epoch") +
  theme_minimal()

## Plot accuracy
ggplot(lstm_history_df, aes(x = epoch)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = accuracy, color = "Training Accuracy")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = val_accuracy, color = "Validation Accuracy")) +
  labs(title = "Training vs. Validation Accuracy", y = "Accuracy", x = "Epoch") +
  theme_minimal()
```
